ira (pm): Heads-up: we have multiple customers still pinning v1.2 and we need a low-friction migration path that preserves customer guarantees while freeing capacity for v2.0 rollout.
charlie (eng): Proposed approach: compatibility shim + staged unpin policy. Shim handles token id mapping + optional legacy KV cache resize. Complexity: adds ~6ms/token and ~5% memory.
nora (research): Acceptance for onboarding: run the canonical eval set + a targeted prompt set for top customers. Pass if metric drift <= 2.5% (LL/ROUGE) and per-prompt regressions < 1.5% absolute. Otherwise flag.
sam (cs): Operational constraints: customers expect 3rd party contracts honored. Recommend default 60-day automatic grace, with pay-to-extend option (30d increments). Also need a standard support checklist.
ijamie (marketing): For launch we need explicit rollout gates so comms can be deterministic. What are the canary pass/fail thresholds?
charlie (eng): Canary gate proposal (nightly job against 0.5% live traffic sample):
- reliability >= 99.6%
- latency_p95 <= baseline_p95 * 1.25
- eval_quality_delta <= 2.5%
- mem_growth <= 8%
If any gate breaches 2 runs in a row -> roll back for affected customers.
canary-bot: Scheduled canary will report to #eng-runtime at 05:30 UTC daily.
ira (pm): Add an opt-in "compat-preview" flag customers can toggle. Also tag in Console: compat: tested/failed/exempt. We should also surface expected perf hit on the model detail page.
sam (cs): I'll prepare three templates: migration invite, extended pin invoice, and escalation note for enterprise CSMs. Need these by Tue.
nora (research): For high-value customers we'll run a per-customer micro-eval harness (10k prompts sample) and block automated rollout if prompt-level loss rate > 1%.
charlie (eng): Implementation timeline:
1) shim POC + unit tests (10 business days)
2) internal canary + dashboard (4 business days)
3) invite beta with 5 customers (10 business days)
4) staged migration windows (4 weeks total, rolling)
We will include an auto-rollback policy per customer.
ira (pm): Acceptance criteria for initiative PR:
- shim deployed to staging with tests
- canary scheduler and dashboard in Console
- comms + templates ready
- opt-in flag + Console tags implemented
- per-customer eval harness integrated for top-10 spenders
Action owners: @charlie build shim, @sam CS templates, @nora eval harness, @jamie prepare comms + FAQ.
jamie (marketing): I'll draft the FAQ and a short dev note showing code snippet for the opt-in: `compat_preview: true` and the Console toggle.
ira (pm): Great. Follow-up sync Thu 10:00 PT to review first internal canary. Thanks everyone.
